interface.shortDescription: Run and design GraphGoblin agent loops
interface.longDescription: Registers the GraphGoblin MCP server (loop discovery, runs, waiting, input, signals, event logs, and threads) and ships three skills: $run-loop starts a loop and reports its result, $design-loop drafts and validates a loop definition, and $inspect-run summarises what a run did.
defaultPrompt: Use $run-loop to run the nightly-triage loop.
Use $design-loop to draft a loop that reviews a pull request until the tests pass.
Use $inspect-run to explain what the last run did.

plugin.description: Run, design, and inspect GraphGoblin agent loops from a Codex session.

skills.name: graphgoblin:design-loop
skills.description: Draft a GraphGoblin loop definition from a plain-language description, validate it against the API, and save it as a draft. Use when the user asks to create, design, sketch, or change a GraphGoblin loop or workflow. Never publishes unless the user explicitly asks.

skills.name: graphgoblin:inspect-run
skills.description: Summarise what a GraphGoblin run did, from its event log and context thread. Use when the user asks why a run failed, what a run produced, or what happened in the last run of a loop.

skills.name: graphgoblin:run-loop
skills.description: Start a named GraphGoblin loop with input, wait for it to finish, and report its result. Use when the user asks to run, trigger, or kick off a GraphGoblin loop or workflow by name.

wait_for_run.name: wait_for_run
wait_for_run.title: Wait for a run
wait_for_run.description: Wait for a run to finish, polling for up to timeoutSeconds (min 1, default 60, max 600 seconds). The finished flag requires terminal execution and run.finalizedAt. Delivery failure is final too: inspect run.deliveries and return.failed events separately from execution status. When fully finalized it returns { finished: true, run } with run.result holding the loop's return value and run.failure explaining a failure. Otherwise it returns { finished: false, status?, cursor?, next }: follow "next". It returns early when the run needs you: waiting for input (call provide_input) or paused (call resume_run). For a long run, keep calling wait_for_run with the same runId. cursor is the last event sequence, usable as "after" in read_run_events. If the deadline expires before any snapshot arrives, status, waiting and cursor are omitted. Deadlines and request cancellation stop observation only; they never cancel the run. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

runId.description: The run id (a ULID) returned by start_run or list_runs.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait, from 1 to 600 seconds. Default 60, max 600.

resume_run.name: resume_run
resume_run.title: Resume the observed run
resume_run.description: Continue the same run id only when get_run.recovery.resume allows it. Pass recovery.observedSeq from that read. A SCRIPT_CONSENT_REQUIRED refusal requires the user to explicitly choose retryUncertainScript; the effect may repeat. A missing session needs the inspector Start fresh session choice or POST /runs/{id}/recover-session, and a child owned by its parent must be resumed through that parent. Stale observations are refused; read get_run again before a new decision. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

runId.description: The run id (a ULID) returned by start_run or list_runs.

read_run_events.name: read_run_events
read_run_events.title: Read run events
read_run_events.description: Read a page of a run's event log in sequence order: node entries and exits, harness items, decisions, waits, and the final run event. Pass after (a sequence number, default 0) and read again with after=nextAfter while hasMore is true. Use it to explain step by step what a run did. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

runId.description: The run id (a ULID) returned by start_run or list_runs.

after.description: Return events with a sequence number greater than this. Default 0.

list_loops.name: list_loops
list_loops.title: List loops
list_loops.description: List the GraphGoblin loops you can run. Call this first when the user names a loop or asks what is available. Returns id, name, description, and whether each loop is published (only published loops can be started without allowDraft). Pass a loop id or equivalent name to describe_loop before starting it. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter loop names and descriptions.

cancel_run.name: cancel_run
cancel_run.title: Cancel a run
cancel_run.description: Cancel a run that is queued, running, waiting, or paused. Only do this when the user asks to stop it. Returns the run; the status becomes cancelled once the engine stops it, so call wait_for_run to confirm. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

runId.description: The run id (a ULID) returned by start_run or list_runs.

replay_run.name: replay_run
replay_run.title: Replay a run from a node
replay_run.description: Debug a run by re-running it from one node: starts a new run (a fork) on the same loop version with the same input, whose context thread is the original run as it was just before that node first started. The source effects, results, history and own recorded deliveries stay unchanged. The fork runs scripts, provider turns, child runs and deliveries on the chosen path again for the new run. Review get_run.recovery.replay[].effects for the knowable node names on possible paths, and pass observedSeq. A path into the current uncertain script additionally requires deliberate retryUncertainScript consent. A missing provider session may use Replay for a deliberate new attempt. Repeated intents return RECOVERY_STALE with the existing fork ID. nodeId must be a node the original run reached (see read_run_events for node.started events). Returns the new run; call wait_for_run with its id to follow it. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

runId.description: The run id (a ULID) returned by start_run or list_runs.

nodeId.description: The node to start the fork at, for example a nodeId from read_run_events.

get_run_thread.name: get_run_thread
get_run_thread.title: Get a run thread
get_run_thread.description: Get a run's context thread reconciled through its durable event log: the messages, variables, artifacts, per-node outputs, last output, and usage counters the loop has accumulated. Use it to explain what a run did or to find an intermediate value. It can be large; prefer get_run when you only need the status or result. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

runId.description: The run id (a ULID) returned by start_run or list_runs.

send_signal.name: send_signal
send_signal.title: Send a signal to a run
send_signal.description: Deliver a named signal to a run, for wait nodes in signal mode (waiting.kind "signal", waiting.signalName) and heartbeat probes that count signals. Pass the waiting.waitId from get_run or wait_for_run as waitId. Returns woke: true when a waiting node consumed it. Then call wait_for_run to follow the run. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

runId.description: The run id (a ULID) returned by start_run or list_runs.

name.description: The signal name, for example waiting.signalName.

waitId.description: The waiting.waitId shown by get_run or wait_for_run.

payload.description: Any JSON value. Match the inputSchema reported by describe_loop or the waiting spec.

list_runs.name: list_runs
list_runs.title: List runs
list_runs.description: List runs, newest first, optionally filtered by loop and status. Use it to find a run the user refers to ("the last run of X"). Returns { items, nextCursor }. Pass a non-null nextCursor as "cursor" with the same filters, even when items is empty; null ends the listing. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

loopId.description: Only runs of this loop id.

status.description: Only runs in one of these statuses.

parentRunId.description: Only child runs of this run; pass "none" for top-level runs only.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page; keep the same filters.

pause_run.name: pause_run
pause_run.title: Pause a run
pause_run.description: Pause a run at the next node boundary when the user asks to hold it. It keeps its state; call resume_run to continue it. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

runId.description: The run id (a ULID) returned by start_run or list_runs.

get_run.name: get_run
get_run.title: Get a run
get_run.description: Get the current snapshot of a run: status, current node, iteration, what it is waiting for, its returned value (including exhausted), its failure details (for node failures), and authoritative recovery eligibility with reason codes and observedSeq. Call this to check a run without waiting; use wait_for_run to wait. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

runId.description: The run id (a ULID) returned by start_run or list_runs.

provide_input.name: provide_input
provide_input.title: Provide input to a waiting run
provide_input.description: Answer a run that is waiting for input (wait_for_run or get_run shows status "waiting" with waiting.kind "input"). Pass waitId from waiting.waitId in that observed snapshot and a value matching waiting.inputSchema; read waiting.prompt to know what is being asked, and ask the user when the answer is theirs to give. Then call wait_for_run again. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

runId.description: The run id (a ULID) returned by start_run or list_runs.

waitId.description: The waiting.waitId shown by get_run or wait_for_run.

input.description: Any JSON value. Match the inputSchema reported by describe_loop or the waiting spec.

start_run.name: start_run
start_run.title: Start a run
start_run.description: Start a run of a loop from a manual trigger. Returns immediately with the runId; the run executes in the background. Then call wait_for_run with that runId to get the result. Pass input matching the trigger inputSchema from describe_loop. triggerNodeId is only needed when the loop has more than one manual trigger. The run keeps the definition it starts with (definition and pinned in the result) even if the loop is edited or published again while it runs. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

loopId.description: The loop id from list_loops, or the loop name (trimmed, whitespace runs collapsed, case-insensitive; no Unicode normalization or full case folding). An exact id takes priority.

input.description: Any JSON value. Match the inputSchema reported by describe_loop or the waiting spec.

triggerNodeId.description: The manual trigger node to start from, when the loop has several.

allowDraft.description: Run the draft version when the loop has no published version: the run pins a snapshot of the draft as it is now. Default false.

describe_loop.name: describe_loop
describe_loop.title: Describe a loop
describe_loop.description: Describe one loop before starting it: its manual triggers with their input JSON schemas, the wait nodes that will ask for input, and each exit node with its return mapping (what the run result will contain). Uses the published version, or the draft when nothing is published. Pass the loop id or equivalent name. Use the trigger inputSchema to build the input for start_run. Triggers have no payload filters; use downstream decisions for payload checks. This tool is part of plugin `GraphGoblin`.

loopId.description: The loop id from list_loops, or the loop name (trimmed, whitespace runs collapsed, case-insensitive; no Unicode normalization or full case folding). An exact id takes priority.

resourceTemplates.name: run-events
resourceTemplates.title: Run event log
resourceTemplates.description: The persisted event log of a run as JSON, in sequence order (up to 10,000 events; page further with read_run_events).

resourceTemplates.name: run-thread
resourceTemplates.title: Run context thread
resourceTemplates.description: The current context thread of a run as JSON: messages, vars, artifacts, outputs.
